story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues

blocks.x: Well, I don't have any air conditioning, as they recommended that they don't want me to have it.
Oh? They don't want you to have it?
No, they don't want me to have it; I asked why, and they said it's not for you.
Well, it's really like canned air, it's not like the real thing.
